The canonical root and sole continuing analytical branch are `series/psycho-pass`. This is one franchise project with installment-local source work and a distinct franchise reconciliation layer. The first intended installment is **Season 1 New Edit / Extended Edition, eleven episodes**. The original twenty-two-episode version is a separate possible comparison witness of the same underlying continuity, with its own identifiers, disclosure order and clocks.

The adopted future role configuration gives an accountable principal continuous AV responsibility for character performance and episode form, with independent source-language/evidence specialists, an independent critical reviewer and a named integrator. Gemini 4 Carbon High is the owner's preferred principal candidate; OpenAI and/or Anthropic are preferred independent specialist/reviewer candidates. The first reading must inspect the complete admitted unit and preserve entering-state hypotheses before finalizing its beginning synopsis. No later-installment source material is licensed by this foundation. Metadata maintenance, evidence preparation under the applicable source rules, and framework corrections may continue within the existing bootstrap scope; substantive episode analysis awaits run authorization and verified first-start gates.

The [method](framework/PP_ANALYTICAL_METHOD.md#governing-method-and-adopted-av-companion) and [protocol](integration/PP_RECONCILIATION_PROTOCOL.md) define the justified policy route without making a vendor name authoritative.

The first reading must inspect the complete admitted unit and preserve entering-state hypotheses before finalizing its beginning synopsis. # Psycho-Pass — Analytical method

This method turns authorized episode evidence into revisable interpretations of persons, institutions, moral arguments and audiovisual form. It establishes questions and tests, not findings about an uninspected story. The [source register](../source-inventory/PP_SOURCE_REGISTER.md) owns exact editions and the [architecture](PP_SYNTHESIS_ARCHITECTURE.md) owns where accepted work lives.

## Governing method and adopted AV companion

The governing method is the [generic anime episode method](../../../governance/analytical-methods/GENERIC_ANIME_EPISODE_ANALYTICAL_METHOD.md). The [continuous audiovisual method](../../../governance/analytical-methods/GENERIC_CONTINUOUS_AUDIOVISUAL_ANALYTICAL_METHOD.md) is its companion for performance, motion, temporal construction and sound-image relations. Apply the [lane-routing policy](../../../governance/source-policies/MANGA_ANIME_MEDIUM_AND_INSPECTION_LANE_ROUTING_POLICY.md), [bundle specification](../../../governance/source-policies/MANGA_ANIME_EPISODE_BUNDLE_SPECIFICATION.md) and [AV reconciliation protocol](../../../governance/source-policies/MANGA_ANIME_AUDIOVISUAL_RECONCILIATION_PROTOCOL.md) together. All anime duties remain operative: source-language inspection, scene construction, causality, character and relationship change, visual grammar, music and sound, uncertainty, counterreadings and cumulative updates.

The adopted local profile is `PP_AV_PRIMARY_CHARACTER_AND_FORM`. It assigns the principal an AV-first character and episode-form study as part of each full reading. Its load-bearing responsibilities are behavioral timing, performed speech and silence, distributed reaction changes, police/social spatial organization, whole-episode editing and pacing, and interactions between sound and image. These cannot always be reconstructed from selected stills and dialogue. The recognized AV-primary mirror route governs the character/AV interpretation, while verified bundle locators and source-language evidence independently support quotations, exact terminology and reproducibility. A continuous viewing does not certify text accuracy, a complete bundle or complete model perception.

For each authorized unit the admission packet must state the actual AV question and its evidence need. Whole-episode continuity may be selected under bundle §§8.2, 8.5 and 8.9 when the assigned responsibility concerns distributed performance or whole-episode construction. That is the intended profile for these extended episodes, subject to a recorded unit-specific rationale. A bounded disputed gesture or synchronization claim may use targeted clips with context. Static inventory, a legible sign or exact wording alone receives `VIDEO_NOT_REQUIRED` where the governing evidence permits it. Do not impose video where it adds no relevant evidence, and do not use a targeted clip to certify a whole episode. If runtime cannot inspect a required channel, record the missing coverage, prepare an adequate faithful route or leave that claim and unit acceptance pending. Provider preference grants no fallback waiver.

## Episode identity, order and disclosure

Use `PP-S01NE-E01` through `PP-S01NE-E11` for New Edit units. A media witness includes edition, immutable hash and clock convention; a later re-encode gets its own witness identity. Original broadcast identifiers `PP-S01OB-E01` through `E22` are reserved for independently verified comparison material. An original pair is not presumed to equal a New Edit episode and no timestamp mapping follows from numbering. Reordered or added material requires a segment-level evidence crosswalk only after both witnesses are admitted for that comparison.

Every episode reading declares entering and terminal knowledge boundaries for the **viewer in the selected edition**, each focal character where material, and the analyst. Freeze entering predictions, uncertainties and candidate explanations before revealing the next unit. Write or finalize its opening synopsis only afterward. Record prior familiarity and later-source exposure, including pretrained knowledge that cannot be excluded. A contaminated analyst may contribute retrospective interpretation with disclosure; that contribution cannot certify a blind prospective inference.

Maintain release availability, in-universe event order and knowledge/disclosure order separately. A flashback's depiction locator, inferred event date and audience disclosure are different fields. Unknown dates remain unknown; an event may have only relative constraints. A later revelation can revise the current franchise conclusion while the historical reading remains valid evidence of what was defensible at its own horizon. New Edit additions may disclose information at a different point from the original edition even when continuity is shared. Never import the later release's knowledge into an earlier prospective freeze.

## Opening story synopsis and episode reconstruction

After source/boundary identification and a compact entering-context statement, each plot-bearing reading begins with a substantial **current-episode story synopsis**, before extended interpretation. It must let a reader reconstruct what happens: situation, important actions in causal order, named participants, decisions, reversals, consequences and the ending state. Preserve significant parallel action and shifts of perspective. Include ordinary and connective scenes when they change relationships, routines, information or the force of a later choice. Identify unresolved causal gaps as gaps.

The synopsis is narrative prose, not a list of themes, claims, timestamps or analyst conclusions. Keep it bounded to this edition and unit; no later explanations. Describe an assertion as something its speaker says, not automatically a world fact. Use known proper names and role/alias distinctions at the legitimate knowledge boundary. A brief synopsis is inadequate if it erases a turning point, a secondary person or the mechanism of a decision. The following scene map supplies precise locators, but does not carry story explanation omitted from the synopsis. Finalize the synopsis after prospective captures freeze so it cannot backfill supposedly prior knowledge.

Reconstruct each consequential sequence as initiating condition → actor's information and options → action/inaction → immediate outcome → changed state. Distinguish shown causality, explicitly reported causality and the analyst's causal hypothesis. Test omitted alternatives, time constraints, coercion and mistaken information before calling a decision freely chosen or inevitable. Keep the episode's actual ordering and transitions alongside any event-order reconstruction.

## Persons, agency and ordinary life

For every differentiated individual, identify what they want, fear, attend to, know and can do at the current boundary. Separate stable disposition, present state, public role, strategy, self-report and another person's attribution. Describe the stimulus, response and consequence behind a psychological inference. Avoid diagnosing a person from a single expressive image, institutional label or numerical display. The work's categories are objects of analysis, not the analyst's validated psychometrics.

Track agency through the alternatives perceived, institutional constraints, available resources, cost of dissent and later consequences. Competence is domain-specific and may change under fatigue, threat, social pressure or familiarity. Record restraint and non-action when the source establishes an available alternative. Preserve contradictory behavior and mundane variation rather than converting a person into an ideology, occupational function or trauma summary.

Attend to routine work, humor, rest, food, material surroundings, preferences, awkwardness, affection and practical care when present. Minor interactions may disclose ordinary baseline behavior that makes a crisis legible. Do not invent such domains to fill a portrait. Their absence is an evidence limit. Keep sexual, romantic or intimate inference specifically sourced, directional, horizon-bounded and open to less intimate explanations.

Track relationships directionally: A's trust, dependence, obligation, knowledge and available influence toward B do not establish B's reciprocity. Record exchanges, repairs, breaches and asymmetries with context. Identify the difference between a rank relation, performed deference, emotional attachment and practical coordination. Group descriptions retain consequential named members and dissenting conduct.

## Institutions, policing and measurement

For Sibyl and each observed institution, distinguish official claim, announced rule, implemented procedure, measured output, actual enforcement, exception and consequence. Ask who observes, who classifies, who acts, who bears error, who can appeal and who benefits. A displayed measurement establishes that an output is displayed at that moment; its validity, interpretation and causal role require evidence. A character's belief in an institution is separately tracked from its demonstrated reliability.

Follow incentives, hierarchy, delegated authority, discretion, resource constraints and accountability through concrete cases. Record whether a claimed constraint is formal, technical, cultural, individual or merely asserted. Consider selective enforcement, incomplete information, dependency and unintended effects. One exception may challenge a universal claim without establishing the opposite universal claim. Do not import external legal, scientific or political categories as settled explanations.

Keep institutional capacity, legitimacy, morality and effectiveness distinct. A procedure can achieve a local aim while imposing an unacknowledged cost; a character can object convincingly yet act inconsistently. Locate the affected people and mechanisms behind abstractions such as order, freedom, safety or responsibility. Institution/world-state records link to source observations, not only to a thematic essay.

## Philosophical claims and narrative support

For a substantial philosophical or political proposition, preserve the speaker, immediate stakes, audience, rhetorical purpose and relevant Japanese wording. State the proposition precisely enough to test. Separate descriptive, causal and normative premises, and identify hidden quantifiers or shifts in what a term means. Track how action, consequence, framing and rival voices support or resist it.

An eloquent speech, a quoted thinker or a visually commanding character is not automatically the work's position. Nor does a speaker's bad conduct logically refute every proposition they state. Test coherence, application and consequences separately. A governing interpretation normally needs at least two materially plausible rival explanations and the strongest source counterexample. Explain why the preferred reading fits better, what it leaves unexplained and what later evidence would change it. Where no confident winner exists, preserve the competition.

Use outside philosophy only when authorized and clearly separated as secondary interpretive context with provenance. Do not retroactively attribute unsaid arguments or unavailable reading to a character. Quotation recognition without verified wording and source is a hypothesis. Avoid turning a case-specific causal conflict into a franchise-wide thesis before the corpus supports that scale.

## Japanese, performance and audiovisual form

Source-language dialogue, visible text, translation and the analyst's gloss are separate witnesses. Preserve names, pronouns, address forms, register changes, ellipsis, negation, modal force and who is addressed when they affect an interpretation. Check decisive wording against the admitted Japanese source and aligned audio/text. Supplier tags and Japanese-script detection do not establish officialness or fidelity. Machine transcription/translation remains an attributed derivative until reviewed. Cite only bounded necessary excerpts, keeping restricted transcripts outside Git.

Observe delivery and listening: pace, hesitation, overlap, volume, breath, emphasis, turn-taking, silence, reaction delay and whether expression is visible or obscured. A subtitle's timing is not proof of the precise spoken interval. An auditory observation requires actual listening; waveform measurement or decoded audio metadata alone does not provide it.

For consequential shots and sequences, describe framing, scale, angle, depth, blocking, gaze, motion, composition, light, color, cut placement and the relation to adjacent shots. Explain the effect in this context and test another explanation such as continuity, genre convention or staging necessity. Record recurring motifs as candidates with variations and counterinstances before asserting a stable symbolism. Do not infer a character's thought directly from color or editing.

Separate dialogue, environmental sound, sound effects, music and silence. Observe entrance/exit, repetition, sound perspective and synchronization with image/action. Distinguish source music from score where supported; uncertainty remains explicit. Record opening/ending/credits/post-credit material within the admitted unit and their evidence roles. Do not drop them merely because they recur, or force fresh interpretation where inspection finds no material change.

Every load-bearing continuous-AV observation follows the [reconciliation protocol](../integration/PP_RECONCILIATION_PROTOCOL.md): actual stream and sampling disclosure, calibration, `REPORTED` versus `ANCHORED`, source reinspection and bounded dispute handling. A sampling limitation can defeat a fine-grained motion claim even when whole-episode semantic coverage is adequate.

Retain the companion's distinct evidence classes: `CAV` for model continuous audiovisual observation, `AO` for model auditory observation, `FRM` for sampled-frame evidence, `TXT` for primary-language text, `AM` for deterministic measurement, `HL` for human listening/viewing, `INF` for supported inference and `INT` for interpretation. An emotion or intention inferred from observed behavior remains INF/INT. Exact timing finer than perceived resolution requires AM; exact wording requires verified TXT. A listening transcription stays an attributed AO/HL observation with uncertainty and is never itself TXT.

## Reading output and acceptance

A complete reading contains the opening story synopsis, source/edition and coverage receipt, scene/causal reconstruction, significant character and directed-relationship changes, institutional/world evidence, Japanese/performance and formal analysis, governing claims with alternatives and counterevidence, and an explicit ending state. Preserve the independent specialists' material contributions and the critical review, including rejected objections and unresolved differences. Give a current corpus status, not a generic checklist claiming every topic is complete.

Each observation gets a stable source-facing ID and each material proposition a stable claim ID. Mark observed event, textual evidence, character assertion, supported inference, hypothetical extrapolation and unknown separately. Coverage and confidence are different axes. A required evidence channel that is partial blocks the affected acceptance; optional gaps have explicit bounded consequences.

Before advancing an authorized high-water mark, accept the complete unit transaction: reading, local evidence/state, local claims/disclosure, necessary master dependencies, qualification reassessment, source locators and independent review dispositions. The principal cannot quietly accept only a synopsis or a ledger while calling the episode complete. The [architecture](PP_SYNTHESIS_ARCHITECTURE.md) and [integration contract](../integration/PP_RECONCILIATION_PROTOCOL.md) govern that transaction and subsequent synthesis.

# Psycho-Pass — Synthesis and franchise architecture

This architecture maintains one franchise root with bounded installment work and provenance-preserving longitudinal synthesis. Its day-one state is administrative: no admitted evidence, portraits, readings, narrative records or accepted claims. The [method](PP_ANALYTICAL_METHOD.md) supplies source-facing analytical duties. This document allocates their durable outputs.

## Canonical responsibilities and justified homes

| Home | Responsibility and update boundary |
| --- | --- |
| [Source register](../source-inventory/PP_SOURCE_REGISTER.md) | Immutable witness identities, available/candidate/admitted distinctions, technical clocks, edition relationships, missing evidence and admission checks. Mutable only through attributed inventory changes. |
| [S1 New Edit evidence/state](../installments/s01-new-edit/PP_S01NE_EVIDENCE_AND_STATE_LEDGER.md) | Primary observations, precise locators, scene causality and installment-bound character/relationship/institution states. Updated in each accepted episode transaction. |
| [S1 New Edit claims/disclosure](../installments/s01-new-edit/PP_S01NE_CLAIM_AND_DISCLOSURE_LEDGER.md) | Prospective freezes, edition-specific audience/character information, local claims, alternatives, revisions and independent-review substance. Per-unit acceptance preserves prior states. |
| [Franchise state](../franchise/ledgers/PP_FRANCHISE_STATE_LEDGER.md) | Current reconciled character, directed relationship and institution/world state; canonical portrait qualification and dependencies. Targeted materialized conclusions with lineage. |
| [Franchise continuity/claims](../franchise/ledgers/PP_CONTINUITY_AND_CLAIM_LEDGER.md) | Release/event/disclosure reconciliation, cross-installment propositions, audiovisual recurrence, contradictions and change lineage. Updates only affected records. |
| [Integration protocol](../integration/PP_RECONCILIATION_PROTOCOL.md) | Role responsibilities, AV evidence reconciliation, change proposals, acceptance, mutable ownership, freezes and handoffs. |
| [Entrypoint](../CURRENT_STATE_AND_CORPUS_MAP.md) | Present authority routes, source/admission boundary, gates and next permitted operation. No narrative replacement or duplicated history. |

Only `installments/s01-new-edit/` exists at bootstrap. The official catalogue identifies additional seasons and films, but no later-source assets have been verified in the inspected inventory and none are admitted. Create a new installment home only when a verified source and authorized responsibility warrant it. Do not create empty film readings, character files, motif studies, audit directories or final syntheses in advance.

Future episode readings belong under `installments/s01-new-edit/readings/PP_S01NE_E##_DEEP_READING.md`, with a structured sequential artifact type. Future local audits and installment synthesis remain in that installment's home with accurate non-sequential types. These are naming contracts, not links to existing files. Each later home declares its own edition/unit scheme, local evidence and claims responsibility, source boundary and route to the same franchise layer. All remain on `series/psycho-pass`; no per-season branches or independent continuities are implied.

## Local observations and materialized franchise synthesis

A local record owns what was observed and concluded at that installment's horizon. The master owns the current reconciled conclusion across admitted material. It must contain enough causal and psychological explanation to be useful without opening every source row, while retaining routes to those rows and readings. Merely copying references or duplicating all local events fails this responsibility.

A master claim includes its affected entity/topic, applicable continuity and knowledge boundary, current assertion and confidence, source installment/edition/unit, stable local evidence/claim IDs, decisive locators, contrary evidence, revision lineage and review disposition. A reader can recover why the present conclusion differs from the earlier one. A master conclusion is derived from source-facing work; its own authority cannot be circular evidence for that work.

During a run, each unit commits its local state and affected dependency markers. Reconcile master changes at a declared tranche or installment boundary, or earlier when a material contradiction would mislead the next unit. If batching is chosen, the entrypoint and affected master records state the actual reconciled boundary and pending delta IDs. Do not label the master current through evidence it has not integrated. No whole-franchise regeneration is required after every episode.

At a boundary, send new findings, character/relationship changes, institutional changes, revised interpretations, continuity disagreements, evidence gaps and proposed specialist obligations as reviewable deltas. The integrator applies accepted targeted edits and preserves rejected/qualified/open decisions. Split a disagreement that concerns both factual chronology and interpretation into separately adjudicable claims. Corrections propagate to their dependent portrait or synthesis and leave historical freezes intact.

## Three chronologies and edition relations

Release chronology records verified first availability of the exact edition or installment, with region/medium where relevant, precision and source. Catalog ordering or a contemporary rebroadcast date is not initial release evidence. In-universe chronology records depicted event dates or relative constraints, their evidence and uncertainty. Disclosure chronology records which character or audience learned what, where and in which edition. Keep time of occurrence, time of representation and time of learning separate even within one scene.

New Edit and original Season 1 share a continuity identity but have distinct source units, runtime clocks and disclosure sequences. Their comparison is a separate authorization and evidence operation. Original-only footage or a different cut may revise an edition claim without creating another fictional timeline. No automatic mapping from New Edit E01 to original E01/E02, no transfer of timestamps and no duplicated coverage credit. If a genuine continuity divergence is later evidenced, record the demonstrated divergence and its scope before changing the model.

The master may hold the latest retrospective interpretation while an earlier local reading remains frozen at its own boundary. A qualified earlier claim is not necessarily an error because later revelation changes it. Distinguish factual correction, previously unavailable information, edition difference and interpretive revision.

## Individuals and one canonical full portrait

Every differentiated named or identifiable subject is considered for monograph qualification; prominence or a preset roster is not the criterion. Review source distribution, independent behavioral pattern, development, relationships, ordinary life, psychological/cognitive evidence and consequential agency. A minor character may qualify; an institution spokesperson does not automatically qualify merely by delivering an important thesis. Keep group/institution studies separate from individual portraits.

The [franchise state ledger](../franchise/ledgers/PP_FRANCHISE_STATE_LEDGER.md) owns each qualification decision with stable subject ID, known names/aliases at relevant disclosure horizons, continuity, assessed source boundary, evidence-based rationale, gaps, trigger and current actual portrait path if one exists. Use the governing statuses `QUALIFIED_PENDING`, `COMPLETE_AT_BOUNDARY`, `DEFERRED_EVIDENCE` and `REASSESS_AFTER_REVISION`. Qualification creates a production obligation. Never claim the character layer complete while qualified portraits remain pending.

The eventual home is `franchise/characters/PP_<SUBJECT>_CHARACTER_MONOGRAPH.md`. Exactly one current canonical full portrait per individual, continuity and declared boundary is routed by the qualification record. Local ledgers preserve scoped states; local readings explain turning points; a new installment does not create a rival biography. Frozen historical portraits remain identifiable as noncurrent, and current mutable portraits carry dated, sourced revisions and supersession routes.

A standalone portrait must be independently usable: identity and embodied presentation, relevant history, motives/emotional patterns, cognition and knowledge, behavioral tendencies, speech and communicative behavior, directed relationships, ordinary life/preferences, source-bounded intimacy, abilities/limits, development across time, conditional behavior profile, uncertainty/contradictions and traceable evidence. Integrate the person into connected explanatory prose with representative scenes. Do not substitute trait tags, ideology labels, selected crisis behavior, a relationship diagram or ledger hyperlinks for a portrait. Unknown and untested domains are stated plainly.

Qualification, portrait completion and reconstruction validation are separate. A strong portrait does not earn a simulation-readiness grade without an independently defined and executed reconstruction validation. Conditional predictions identify their assumptions and extrapolation limits. No psychological diagnosis or unseen personal history is inferred simply to fill required sections.

Two independent assessments are required for completion at a boundary: **self-containment**, asking whether a reader can understand and distinguish the person without chasing missing narrative into ledgers; and **source fidelity**, checking representative decisive evidence, conflicting cases, baseline behavior, major relationships and meaningful transitions against the admitted sources. Sample introduction, middle and latest/exit material where present. Record coverage and limitations; one favorable example cannot certify the whole portrait. Meaningful shortcomings reopen the qualification record and dependent claims.

## Specialist and franchise synthesis

Create a relationship study when a sustained reciprocal/asymmetric system needs more explanatory space than current-state rows. Create an institutional study when procedures, authority, incentives, exceptions and historical change need joint examination. Philosophical/thematic and audiovisual studies require accumulated evidence, counterinstances and a real cross-unit question. Their material belongs in coherent analysis with source lineage, not a directory of short isolated motif entries.

Substantial installment synthesis reconciles its local readings and ledger state, changes over the installment, formal construction, unresolved contradictions and implications for existing master claims. A franchise synthesis becomes warranted only by admitted multi-installment evidence. It must preserve differences between eras, genres, focalizers and editions, not flatten them into a single formula. Fresh synthesis sessions retrieve actual accepted evidence, substantial independent findings and source routes before drafting.

A specialist synthesis may propose a change to another authoritative home, but the proposal is not automatically accepted authority. The local integrator checks its evidence, source horizon and dependencies, resolves targeted convergence and updates the owning record. Required channel deficits or unresolved load-bearing factual disputes block the relevant synthesis completion. Optional enrichment may stay open with a bounded effect and follow-up trigger.

## Extension and distinct completion gates

Extend this architecture when a dimension recurs, develops independent evidence, affects later synthesis or requires retrieval that existing homes cannot support. Assign one owner and canonical home, state why the present ledgers are inadequate, and update the current map and architecture revision history. Do not create a parallel authoritative home for an existing responsibility. Backfill only material evidence gaps that cannot be repaired responsibly from retained readings and primary evidence; a new question does not automatically mandate rereading the entire franchise.

Completion is assessed for an explicit installment, tranche or franchise boundary. These six states are distinct:

| Gate | Evidence required before passage |
| --- | --- |
| Sequential-source completion | Every authorized required unit has a complete accepted episode transaction, including synopsis, source coverage, independent contributions and review. No unauthorized or merely inventoried source counts. |
| Longitudinal reconciliation | Local states and claims are current at that boundary; affected master deltas, disclosure/chronology differences, revisions and dependencies are adjudicated. Material unresolved gaps are recorded as incomplete, not silently carried into a current-state claim. |
| Specialist-synthesis readiness | Required source channels and actual evidence packages are adequate for each proposed specialist responsibility. Conduct all-subject monograph qualification no later than this gate, expose qualified pending obligations, and identify the specialist's exact sources, rivals and open issues. Readiness permits defined specialist work, not a claim that its deliverables are complete. |
| Full-series synthesis readiness | An architecture/role-gap review verifies that source-derived responsibilities, required specialist work, qualified portraits, cumulative reconciliation and necessary revisions are satisfied for the declared scope. Sequential completion alone does not pass this gate. |
| Validation/audit completion | Independent substantive review verifies decisive evidence, causal/character transitions, three-clock integrity, self-containment, source fidelity, significant omissions and disposition of required corrections. Mechanical links/schema checks are additional, not substitutes. |
| Frozen/release state | Accepted exact artifact versions, source boundaries, open optional issues, current/noncurrent routes and dependency state are preserved and release-audited under live publication governance. Any run/terminal closure is a separate applicable controlled transaction. |

The ordinary dependency order is accepted units → reconciled state → specialist readiness/work → full-series readiness/work → validation → release. Bounded specialist work may occur earlier with an explicit narrower source boundary. No early task relabels the later gate complete. All six narrative completion states are currently **NOT_REACHED** because source admission is NONE.

Initial architecture history: version 1.0 establishes these responsibilities at PP-INITIAL. Future material amendments record their reason, affected homes, boundary and backfill decision here and update the current map.

## Execution ownership and reasoning

The [reasoning policy](../../../governance/source-policies/MANGA_ANIME_REASONING_AND_MODEL_ROUTING_POLICY.md) classifies work separately from provider choice. Mechanical hash/routing work is `ROUTINE_FAST`; inventory reconciliation is normally `BOUNDED_STANDARD`; mature sequential reading and bounded specialist work begin at `SUBSTANTIVE_ANALYSIS`; portrait, contradiction and cross-installment synthesis usually require `DEEP_SYNTHESIS`. Architecture and propagation-sensitive reconciliation may warrant `PREMIUM_QUALITY_FIRST` with a stated reliability benefit. More tokens never replace inaccessible evidence.

The principal owns complete source coverage and draft readings. Independent specialists own their assigned source-based findings, normally Japanese/institutional argument and performance/form as appropriate to the unit. The separate critical reviewer tests decisive evidence, the strongest rival explanations and omissions. The named analytical integrator alone edits shared current ledgers, accepts changes and controls dependency propagation. The repository integration owner handles exact-path publication under live governance. One person may hold principal/integrator responsibility with disclosure; they cannot be their own independent reviewer.

The owner prefers Gemini 4 Carbon High for principal continuous-AV work and OpenAI and/or Anthropic for independent specialties and critical adjudication. These are replaceable candidates. Capability verification, independence and evidence quality determine actual assignment. No model name provides a tie-breaker, and no reduced multi-agent configuration is planned for these extended, multi-channel episodes.

Long-series work follows the [hybrid protocol](../../../governance/source-policies/MANGA_ANIME_LONG_SERIES_HYBRID_EXECUTION_PROTOCOL.md): synchronized local source reading/ledgers, fresh adequately grounded synthesis sessions, and local acceptance/integration. Fresh cloud Pro is the preferred synthesis environment when it can receive the necessary lawful evidence and handoff, not a claim of universally superior interpretation. Actual working topology, capability and provider are recorded per run.

A checkpoint freezes accepted readings, prospective captures and independent observation/review records. Current ledgers, entrypoint and full portraits remain mutable through attributed revisions; source hashes are immutable and changed bytes create new witnesses. The [handoff contract](../../../governance/source-policies/MANGA_ANIME_ANALYTICAL_HANDOFF_AND_INTEGRATION_CONTRACT.md), [archive policy](../../../governance/source-policies/ARCHIVE_AUTHORITY_AND_SUPERSESSION_POLICY.md) and [local protocol](../integration/PP_RECONCILIATION_PROTOCOL.md) govern actual-byte handoffs, freeze protection and supersession. This initial CLOSED state has no historical run to seal.

# Franchise chronology and claim reconciliation

This is the current canonical home for cross-installment chronology/disclosure reconciliation, philosophical/thematic claims, recurring audiovisual patterns and unresolved continuity disagreements. **Current reconciled records through `PP-S01NE-E11` (Season 1 New Edit complete, `11/11 = 100%`): 24 chronology/edition records (`PP-CHR-0001`–`0024`), 44 franchise claims (`PP-FCLM-0001`–`0044`), 67 accepted reconciliation deltas (`PP-DELTA-0001`–`0067`).** Official release/edition metadata remains in the [source register](../../source-inventory/PP_SOURCE_REGISTER.md); inventory entries are not narrative records.

## Three separate temporal dimensions

A chronology record `PP-CHR-####` explicitly distinguishes these fields:

| Dimension | Required content and safeguards |
| --- | --- |
| Release | Exact edition/installment, verified first availability and medium/region, precision and metadata provenance. An unknown date stays unknown; a rebroadcast date cannot silently replace initial publication. |
| Event | Depicted or inferred in-universe event date/relative constraint, supporting observation IDs and locators, precision/confidence and conflicts. Episode order does not prove event order. |
| Disclosure | Proposition, audience edition or named character, earliest supported acquisition/belief boundary, source unit/locator and reliability. Analyst awareness and prior exposure remain separate. |

Use a partial order where the source gives only before/after constraints. Do not invent a total timeline, a calendar date or an interval duration to make a chart look complete. Store presentation order separately when it differs from event order. One occurrence can have multiple disclosure records and one release can reveal several different event times.

The current source model reserves New Edit and original broadcast as edition witnesses of the same continuity. Original broadcast coverage is zero. Cross-edition comparison requires independently admitted bytes and segment mapping; numbering alone creates no correspondence. Later revelations may change a current event hypothesis or institutional explanation without altering earlier prospective freezes. A genuine conflicting source claim remains a conflict until adjudicated; it is not automatically a different continuity.

## Reconciled proposition and motif records

A franchise proposition uses `PP-FCLM-####`. Record its exact assertion, kind and scope, current admitted/reconciled boundary, local claim/evidence lineage by installment/edition/unit, decisive locators, counterexamples, rival explanation, confidence, dependencies and accepted transition. Explain how contributions from different installments agree or differ. Do not erase scale, focalizer, exception or uncertainty to produce a short universal statement.

For a philosophical proposition, identify its attributed speaker and argumentative premises separately from the analyst's claim about narrative support. For a formal motif, record occurrences and absences/variants where inspected, actual audiovisual features, possible function and competing explanations. A shared color, composition or musical phrase does not establish shared meaning without contextual evidence. A formal recurrence can change function across time.

New findings and old-claim adjudications have separate identities even when later integrated together. The [state ledger](PP_FRANCHISE_STATE_LEDGER.md) owns current people/relationship/institution states; this ledger owns the cross-source proposition and revision reasoning. Link rather than independently rewrite the other owner's conclusion.

## Deltas, disagreements and authority

Each local proposal `PP-DELTA-####` identifies its base master version, proposed affected records, before/after assertion, source lineage, evidence gaps, required/optional status, prospective/retrospective effect and dependent artifacts. The [protocol](../../integration/PP_RECONCILIATION_PROTOCOL.md) owns adjudication. Record accepted, qualified, rejected or open integration outcomes and the corresponding claim transition. Preserve material dissent and the evidence that could resolve it.

Classify a disagreement as factual/locator, language, edition, chronology/disclosure, causal or interpretive before deciding its remedy. Correct factual coordinates and propagate their consequences. Compare interpretive alternatives against shared evidence. An unresolved optional interpretation can remain OPEN; an unresolved required fact or channel blocks the affected accepted conclusion or synthesis. Neither majority vote nor provider reputation determines truth.

Historical local readings and prediction freezes remain source-horizon artifacts. Current master claims may be revised through attributed lineage. Public summaries must route to the current accepted version and identify which parts remain open. Reconciliation updates targeted records, not the entire master corpus after every episode.

# Franchise state and portrait qualification

This is the single current canonical home for reconciled character, directed relationship and institution/world state across admitted installments. It also owns individual portrait qualification and the route to each current full portrait. **Current reconciled records through `PP-S01NE-E11` (Season 1 New Edit complete, `11/11 = 100%`): 75 entities (`PP-ENT-0001`–`0075`, with `PP-ENT-0015` resolved to `PP-ENT-0031` Mitsuru Sasayama), 36 materialized states (`PP-FSTATE-0001`–`0036`), 53 individual/documentary person qualification assessments formally adjudicated at Season 1 Close (`6` core full/closed-arc monographs READY [`Akane Tsunemori`, `Shinya Kōgami`, `Shōgo Makishima` (deceased E11), `Nobuchika Ginoza`, `Masaoka` (deceased E11), `Shūsei Kagari` (deceased E08)], `1` core monograph READY w/ open caveat [`Yayoi Kunizuka` — Rina `2113` fate open], `2` closed secondary/supporting arcs READY [`Choi Gu-sung` (deceased E08), `Kōzaburō Tōma` (deceased E09)], `1` institutional/vessel dossier READY [`Jōshū Kasei` / Sibyl], `2` partial supporting profiles `DEFERRED_EVIDENCE` [`Shion Karanomori`, `Jōji Saiga`], `1` Tier-1 promoted finale seed `DEFERRED_EVIDENCE` [`Mika Shimotsuki`], plus `40` episodic/documentary subjects `DEFERRED_EVIDENCE`; `15` institutions/collectives/venues/sites; `5` `NOT_APPLICABLE` non-human AI/hardware/infrastructure; `2` virtual avatars tracked via operators), 0 pending monograph obligations, 0 completed portraits (honestly retained at close of the owner-authorized continuous sequential episode run `E01–E11`, awaiting separate owner authorization for any standalone character monographs).**

## Materialized state contract

Give each person/institution a stable `PP-ENT-####` ID once evidence supports identity. Preserve source-language name, transliteration and meaningful aliases with their legitimate knowledge boundaries. Unknown/provisional identities remain distinct until evidenced equivalence. Record continuity and any source-scoped identity uncertainty.

A state record `PP-FSTATE-####` includes subject and domain, current reconciled conclusion in explanatory prose, boundary through which it is current, contributing installment/edition/unit/local state and claim IDs, decisive locators, contrary cases, confidence and transition history. Explain the mechanism behind a claimed change; a stack of trait labels or links is insufficient. Local observations remain in their source ledger. The master stores only material synthesis and its lineage.

For a person, preserve stable tendencies, changing circumstances, goals, beliefs/knowledge, competencies/limits, self-presentation and meaningful ordinary behavior separately. Do not merge a later identity revelation with what another character knew earlier. For relationships, the canonical key includes A → B and dimension; reciprocity requires separate evidence. For institutions, distinguish professed authority, implemented behavior, constraints, exceptions and consequences. A measurement output remains different from a validated description of a person.

## Qualification register contract

At the first accepted episode, each new differentiated individual is considered; reassess on substantive new evidence and at every declared tranche/installment synthesis boundary. The qualification record carries subject ID/name, continuity, assessed boundary, evidence distribution, rationale, gaps, next review trigger and the actual canonical portrait path once it exists. No name-only roster or fixed lead-character quota controls this decision.

Use `QUALIFIED_PENDING` when sufficient differentiated evidence creates a portrait production obligation, `DEFERRED_EVIDENCE` with a concrete gap/review trigger, `COMPLETE_AT_BOUNDARY` only after both required reviews, and `REASSESS_AFTER_REVISION` when material evidence or correction changes the portrait's basis. An unavailable portrait path is stated as absent rather than linked as if it exists. Counts of pending obligations remain visible in the current handoff.

The [architecture](../../framework/PP_SYNTHESIS_ARCHITECTURE.md#individuals-and-one-canonical-full-portrait) defines the full portrait standard and intended home `franchise/characters/PP_<SUBJECT>_CHARACTER_MONOGRAPH.md`. There is one current full portrait per person/continuity/boundary. Installment states and historical snapshots are scoped evidence, not competing current portraits.

A completion decision names the exact portrait bytes and declared boundary, independent self-containment review and independent source-fidelity review, actual source sample/coverage, required revisions and their disposition, and residual limits. Both reviews must pass for the declared scope; a complete checklist with missing causal/ordinary-life/relationship substance fails. Unknown domains remain stated, not fabricated. Portrait completion does not certify operational reconstruction or simulation readiness.

## Incremental integration and dependencies

The integrator applies accepted local deltas to affected state and qualification records, preserving the previous conclusion and reason for change. A new state with cross-installment consequences also links the [continuity/claim ledger](PP_CONTINUITY_AND_CLAIM_LEDGER.md). If not yet reconciled, keep the older materialized boundary visible with the pending delta ID; do not silently borrow the latest local wording.

A changed psychological, relationship or institutional conclusion identifies dependent portraits, specialist studies and syntheses. Update affected living portraits through dated sourced additions or mark them for reassessment. Frozen prior versions retain their authority boundary and supersession route. At a synthesis boundary, reconcile pending changes and qualification obligations or accurately state that the affected layer is incomplete.

The master never adjudicates a fact solely by citing itself. Reopen decisive source evidence through installment/edition/unit locators under the [integration protocol](../../integration/PP_RECONCILIATION_PROTOCOL.md).

# S1 New Edit — Claims and disclosure

**Accepted records through `PP-S01NE-E11` (Season 1 New Edit complete, `11/11 = 100%`): 132 local claims (`CLM-0001`–`0132`), 11 frozen prospective records (`PP-S01NE-PRE-0001`–`0011`), 105 disclosure events (`DISC-0001`–`0105`), 110 adjudicated multi-agent disputes (`DSP-01`–`110`), 5 retained post-Season 1 `OPEN` horizon questions.** This ledger preserves the installment's changing explanations and legitimate knowledge, complementing [source observations](PP_S01NE_EVIDENCE_AND_STATE_LEDGER.md). It is not a prewritten philosophical reading.

## Prospective and disclosure records

Before the next authorized unit, freeze the entering boundary, current explanation, plausible alternatives, unresolved questions and conditional predictions. Give the freeze a stable `PP-S01NE-PRE-####` identity, exact artifact/version hash, source cutoff, writer and actual prior exposure. Preserve this record before source exposure and before finalizing the next reading's opening synopsis. A prediction distinguishes observation from extrapolation and states what would count for or against it. Silence about a future event is not a successful prediction.

A disclosure record `PP-S01NE-DISC-####` identifies the proposition or event, who knows/believes/suspects it, how it is acquired, exact edition/unit/locator, reliability and the earliest evidenced boundary. Audience access, focal-character access and analyst awareness are separate fields. Knowledge is not automatically shared across a scene, organization or relationship. Distinguish hearing a report, believing it and the underlying fact.

In-universe event dates or relative ordering are linked evidence constraints, not computed from the episode number. Release dates are metadata with independent provenance. For New Edit material, record its position in this version without inferring original-broadcast audience knowledge. If an authorized original-edition comparison later identifies inserted or reordered disclosure, create a paired crosswalk and separate edition horizons. Do not silently retitle an earlier freeze as if it had always contained later knowledge.

## Claims, alternatives and corrections

A material local claim uses `PP-S01NE-CLM-####`. Preserve its proposition, scope and continuity, applicable source/knowledge boundary, claim kind, supporting observation IDs/locators, contrary evidence, strongest alternatives, confidence, falsification/review trigger, dependencies and acceptance history. A character's claim about Sibyl, morality or another person is tagged as that character's assertion before any analytical endorsement.

Claim kinds distinguish observed/descriptive proposition, causal inference, psychological inference, normative argument attribution, formal interpretation and explicit speculation. A complex paragraph can require multiple claims when different evidence bears on its parts. Do not let an abstract thesis conceal an unverified fact or missing causal step. Two plausible rivals are expected for a governing interpretation; record why the evidence discriminates among them or why it does not.

Use the AV protocol's transitions where applicable: `PRESERVE`, `STRENGTHEN`, `REVISE`, `DOWNGRADE`, `REJECT`, `OPEN`. Each disposition states the prior claim/version, new evidence or argument, source boundary, reviewer and resulting assertion. Preserve rejected interpretations and the reason for rejection. Distinguish a factual error, a new disclosure, a witness difference and a legitimate changed interpretation. Revised claim IDs retain lineage rather than being silently reused for a different proposition.

## Independent work and compression checks

The durable unit checkpoint retains each assignment, source scope actually inspected, independence/exposure state, substantive observations, rival explanation, counterexample and final disposition. A reviewer reacting only to the principal's prose has not verified the source. Fresh neutral-source inspection is preferred before claims exposure. A contaminated reviewer records the limitation and cannot certify blindness.

Review whether synopsis and analysis preserve consequential secondary persons, ordinary scenes, Japanese rhetorical distinctions, causal options, directed relationships, institutional exceptions and audiovisual evidence. Check for unjustified trait generalization, ideological reduction, erased counterexamples and a source event converted into an overbroad thesis. Objection count and agreement rate are not quality measures. A rejected objection must retain the evidence-based reason; disagreement alone is not a revision mandate.

A new independent finding is separately identified before assessing whether it changes an existing claim. If local claims affect the current franchise understanding, send a bounded delta with evidence, uncertainty and dependency paths to the [master continuity/claim ledger](../../franchise/ledgers/PP_CONTINUITY_AND_CLAIM_LEDGER.md). Keep frozen local conclusions visible at their historical horizon even after master revision.

This is the current canonical source-observation and installment-state home for the intended eleven New Edit units. **Accepted records through `PP-S01NE-E11` (Season 1 New Edit complete, `11/11 = 100%`): 251 anchored observations (`E01-OBS-0001`–`0026`, `E02-OBS-0001`–`0024`, `E03-OBS-0001`–`0025`, `E04-OBS-0001`–`0022`, `E05-OBS-0001`–`0022`, `E06-OBS-0001`–`0022`, `E07-OBS-0001`–`0022`, `E08-OBS-0001`–`0022`, `E09-OBS-0001`–`0022`, `E10-OBS-0001`–`0022`, `E11-OBS-0001`–`0022`), 222 scene reconstructions (`E01: SC-01`–`SC-13`, `E02: SC-01`–`SC-16`, `E03: SC-01`–`SC-25`, `E04: SC-01`–`SC-21`, `E05: SC-01`–`SC-22`, `E06: SC-01`–`SC-21`, `E07: SC-01`–`SC-22`, `E08: SC-01`–`SC-19`, `E09: SC-01`–`SC-24`, `E10: SC-01`–`SC-23`, `E11: SC-01`–`SC-16`), 149 local states (`STATE-0001`–`0149`).** The contract below governs all episode transactions.

## Identity and source-facing records

An observation uses `PP-S01NE-E##-OBS-####`; IDs never recycle or change with interpretation. Its mandatory payload is unit ID, exact witness ID and SHA-256 reference from the [source register](../../source-inventory/PP_SOURCE_REGISTER.md), source edition, clock convention, start/end locator, scene ID, observation type, inspectable description, inspector/date, actual modality and any sampling or access limit. Exact dialogue adds text-witness ID, cue/line locator, language, aligned audiovisual interval and whether original wording, subtitle transcription or analytical translation.

Observation types separate directly viewed action/image, directly heard performance/sound, inspected text, character/institution assertion and analyst inference. An inference links the observations from which it follows and its local claim ID; it does not overwrite the observed event. `REPORTED` AV locators are retrieval candidates until reinspected and `ANCHORED` under the [protocol](../../integration/PP_RECONCILIATION_PROTOCOL.md). A timestamp precise to milliseconds does not establish perceptual timing accuracy.

Source coverage is recorded by meaningful scene/segment, including ordinary connective action, OP/ED, credits and post-credit material within the admitted source. List inspected versus missing intervals, continuity breaks, text route, audio route and visual route. Requirement (`REQUIRED`, `OPTIONAL`, `OUT_OF_SCOPE`) and inspection (`COMPLETE_FOR_DECLARED_SCOPE`, `PARTIAL`, `PENDING`, `UNAVAILABLE`, `NOT_APPLICABLE`) are independent. No checksum, extracted frame count or transcript cue count certifies perceptual completion.

Each scene reconstruction preserves presented order, relevant event-time constraint, persons and their information, action/choice, immediate consequence and changed state. It links the reading's narrative prose rather than replacing it. Unknown event dates and inferred offscreen actions remain marked.

## Local state and changes

A local state ID is `PP-S01NE-STATE-####` with versions tied to accepted unit boundaries. Record entity ID, state domain, entering state, source-supported change, resulting state, evidence and local claim IDs, counterevidence, uncertainty and review disposition. Preserve prior states and the transition mechanism. A later-looking summary without transition evidence is insufficient.

Character state separates goals, knowledge, affect, competencies/limits, public role, self-report and supported disposition. Directed relationship state carries subject → object, trust/dependence/obligation/authority/intimacy dimensions as supported, asymmetric information and the concrete exchange behind change. Institution state separates claimed norm, actual process, displayed measurement, enforcement, exception and affected person's consequence. These are installment-scoped records, never rival full biographies or automatically current franchise conclusions.

Known persons use a stable entity ID from the franchise state ledger, a proper name known at this boundary and any purposeful role/alias. If identity is not established, a local provisional ID is used and later linked without backfilling the earlier knowledge boundary. Do not replace recurring named subjects with generic role labels that make their actions hard to retrieve.

## Per-unit maintenance and dependencies

The principal proposes source and state updates with the completed reading. Independent specialists supply their actual source observations; the critical reviewer checks load-bearing source spans, significant omitted persons/scenes and disputed transitions. The integrator alone accepts shared changes. Every material state transition has a route into the [local claim/disclosure ledger](PP_S01NE_CLAIM_AND_DISCLOSURE_LEDGER.md).

At each accepted unit, identify potential franchise implications and existing portrait dependencies. A change that is merely new local detail stays local. A materially changed disposition, directed bond, institutional rule or contradiction becomes a numbered delta under the [reconciliation protocol](../../integration/PP_RECONCILIATION_PROTOCOL.md). If master integration is batched, record the pending delta and the master's earlier boundary; never imply that the master already reflects it.

Corrections retain the original observation identity, describe corrected versus earlier content and link the claim revision. Changed source bytes create another witness. Frozen readings and independent logs remain intact; current ledger entries retain their lineage. The [franchise state ledger](../../franchise/ledgers/PP_FRANCHISE_STATE_LEDGER.md) owns current reconciled conclusions and monograph qualification, not this document.

# Independent AV and franchise reconciliation

This is the operational contract for the adopted `PP_AV_PRIMARY_CHARACTER_AND_FORM` method family and for local-to-franchise integration. It implements the [AV reconciliation protocol](../../../governance/source-policies/MANGA_ANIME_AUDIOVISUAL_RECONCILIATION_PROTOCOL.md), [topology §4.1](../../../governance/source-policies/MANGA_ANIME_EXECUTION_TOPOLOGY_AND_CAPABILITY_ROUTING_POLICY.md#multi-agent-source-reading), [bundle specification](../../../governance/source-policies/MANGA_ANIME_EPISODE_BUNDLE_SPECIFICATION.md) and [handoff contract](../../../governance/source-policies/MANGA_ANIME_ANALYTICAL_HANDOFF_AND_INTEGRATION_CONTRACT.md). It introduces no global exception. **No role has performed narrative analysis or verified a model capability during bootstrap.**

## First-start role and capability receipt

Before an authorized first unit, record the owner grant, run start/end, single-operation or explicitly bounded continuation mode, stop conditions, topology, role assignments and source/knowledge boundaries. The [continuation policy](../../../governance/source-policies/MANGA_ANIME_SEQUENTIAL_EXECUTION_SCOPE_AND_CONTINUATION_POLICY.md) controls run extent. A plan is not permission to continue through the franchise.

The principal inspects the complete required unit and owns draft synthesis. An independent source-language/argument specialist checks decisive Japanese wording, assertions, reasoning and institutional claims against the source. An independent AV/character specialist examines assigned performance/form evidence and meaningful behavioral alternatives. Assign at least one genuinely substantive independent specialist for every unit, selecting or combining those specialist responsibilities only when competence and coverage support it. The separate critical reviewer inspects decisive evidence and tests major claims, omitted scenes/persons, contrary cases and transition errors. The analytical integrator owns shared ledgers and acceptance; record if this is also the principal. No reduced source-reading configuration is preapproved for these extended episodes.

The owner prefers Gemini 4 Carbon High as principal continuous-AV analyst and independently operating OpenAI and/or Anthropic contexts for specialist/reviewer work. Resolve those roles to actually available capable runtimes. Record exact provider/model/surface, reasoning configuration where exposed, input support, image/video sampling information, direct-listening support, duration/context/transport constraints and successful source-access checks. Distinguish verified capability, provider documentation, owner preference and unverified expectation. Do not execute benchmarks or probes merely because this foundation names them.

Independent contexts receive the bounded sources and neutral assignment, not the principal's interpretation. Freeze their observations before claims exposure where feasible. Record actual prior exposure and `blind_order_achieved`; set false when the order or independence is compromised. Source-aware critical review still has value after exposure but cannot be reported as blind. If required roles or channels cannot be satisfied, pause acceptance at the last valid checkpoint rather than replacing independent source work with approval of prose.

## Evidence package and clocks

A complete episode bundle must satisfy all semantic responsibilities of the current specification: source identity and provenance, source-relative citation clock, visual evidence/index, dialogue/source-language route, linkage among evidence objects, audio access, coverage/quality assurance and retrievable artifact inventory. A source MKV plus unmatched subtitles is not a complete bundle. A partially prepared bundle is labelled partial with its missing responsibilities and blocked claims.

Bind every transported media/clip/derivative to the original witness hash, exact source interval, stream choice and transformation manifest. Record source-relative time and derivative-relative time separately, including offsets, cropping, resampling, encoding and audio handling. Keep originals, extracted frames/audio/subtitles and private manifests in authorized source/work environments. Public analytical Git contains safe metadata, derived analysis and necessary bounded quotations, without machine paths, account IDs or restricted media.

For New Edit source time, use `HH:MM:SS.mmm` relative to the recorded media origin, not player wall time or a TV subtitle clock. Calibrate with at least opening, middle and closing audiovisual anchors for full-episode inspection. For clips, verify endpoints and an interior anchor, preserving the source offset and adequate context. Record measured subtitle/audio alignment and residual error. Default ordinary navigation tolerance is ±0.5 seconds only when demonstrated by calibration; rapid action, turn timing, lip synchronization or sound-image order may demand frame/sample-level checks.

The available TV subtitle clocks exceed the candidate BD durations. Treat their timing as unaligned evidence, with possible cut/ad/edition differences. No assumed constant offset or original-broadcast pair mapping is permitted. BD-labelled ASS01/02 also require verification. Text synchronization, text accuracy and language identification are separate acceptance questions. E04 needs an adequate authorized Japanese evidence route before its required text claims can be complete; E11 spoken language requires actual verification because its track is untagged.

An ffprobe report establishes container metadata, not decoding completeness or model perception. A 23.976fps source does not prove that an inspecting model saw 23.976 frames per second. Record known sampling and unknown sampling explicitly. The files are approximately 1.7–2.6 GB; check actual runtime transport limits, not historical tool limits quoted in policy. Prepare the smallest faithful derivative appropriate to the evidence need, preserving relevant timing, visual detail and audio. If compression or sampling could remove the decisive feature, escalate source inspection and narrow the conclusion until adequate.

## AV-primary mirror workflow

1. Select the unit's actual AV responsibility under the [method](../framework/PP_ANALYTICAL_METHOD.md#governing-method-and-adopted-av-companion). Document why whole-episode continuity, targeted clips or `VIDEO_NOT_REQUIRED` matches it. Verify source/bundle identity and freeze entering hypotheses.
2. Issue a neutral observation packet with exact source IDs, bounded intervals, context, calibration task and uncertainties. It contains no preferred reading or desired adjudication. The principal's AV-first interpretation is a proposed analysis, not current authority merely because it is primary.
3. Freeze independent observations and source-language findings before supplying the claims packet where feasible. Preserve observation IDs, actual inspected scope and exposure record. If an analyst cannot directly listen/view, its output cannot be labelled a direct sound/motion observation.
4. Reinspect every load-bearing AV observation at its claimed source coordinates. Initial recalled timestamps are `REPORTED`. An observation becomes `ANCHORED` only when it is calibrated to a source interval and cue/frame, actually re-viewed or reheard, resolvable within the inspecting route's effective sampling and temporal precision, and supported by the corroboration required for that claim. Record inspector, anchors, resolution and confirmation evidence. Relocating a timestamp alone does not pass. Verify decisive quotations/terminology through the independent Japanese route. Listening-based transcription retains audio-observation or human-listening status and uncertainty until a distinct verified text witness supports TXT; hearing speech is not itself TXT verification. Bundle anchors and AV observations constrain each other.
5. The critical reviewer tests the principal and specialist interpretations against decisive source spans, best counterexamples and meaningful alternatives. Distinguish new findings from adjudications of earlier claims. State what source evidence actually discriminates between explanations.
6. For a material disagreement, return once for bounded clarification/reinspection, then obtain one independent verification pass where needed. If unresolved, retain `OPEN`, competing readings and the precise missing discriminator. Required unresolved facts or missing channels block the affected acceptance. Avoid indefinite review loops or automatic replacement on disagreement alone.
7. The integrator chooses `PRESERVE`, `STRENGTHEN`, `REVISE`, `DOWNGRADE`, `REJECT` or `OPEN` for each material claim, with source-grounded reasons and dependencies. Confidence follows evidence and limitations. No model's status or majority agreement is a tie-breaker.

A later transcript/bundle challenge to an AV-primary interpretation is part of this mirror process. Exact wording can correct an AV paraphrase; direct motion/listening can correct an inference from a static or textual view. Neither channel automatically settles every question.

## Episode transaction and franchise proposals

A valid episode checkpoint contains the complete reading with beginning synopsis, source/coverage receipt, local observations and states, claim/disclosure changes, independent assignments and actual findings, reviewer objections/counterexamples, dispositions, pending evidence gaps and qualification/dependency review. Preserve substantive findings in the checkpoint or exact durable linked artifact; a line saying “specialist agreed” is inadequate.

The integrator atomically accepts that transaction before any high-water advance. An interrupted run preserves drafts as incomplete, recovers the last accepted boundary and does not infer completion from filenames. Required corrections are applied or acceptance remains pending. Optional unresolved interpretations state their bounded effect and trigger.

At a declared tranche/installment boundary, the local analyst submits `PP-DELTA-####` proposals identifying:
- new findings and changed character, directed relationship or institution/world state;
- revised/challenged interpretations and strongest counterevidence;
- chronology, continuity, edition or disclosure disagreements;
- evidence gaps, unresolved questions and proposed specialist/portrait obligations;
- exact affected master records, base versions, proposed before/after text and dependencies.

The integrator checks freshness and source lineage, accepts, qualifies, rejects or leaves open each proposal, and edits only affected authoritative records. Link the outcome to the applicable claim-transition vocabulary. A qualified acceptance narrows the conclusion explicitly. Stale bases require reconciliation before mutation. Record the master's actual reconciled boundary and pending deltas until materialization completes. Keep local observations and historical horizon conclusions in their original home.

## Freezes, handoff and completion

Accepted source-facing readings, pre-unit freezes and independent observation/review logs freeze at their declared checkpoint. Current ledgers, maps and designated living portraits change only through attributed, reviewable revisions. A correction to a frozen reading is a linked erratum or superseding artifact under the [archive policy](../../../governance/source-policies/ARCHIVE_AUTHORITY_AND_SUPERSESSION_POLICY.md), preserving the original bytes and source horizon. Never silently rewrite a prospective record to resemble hindsight.

A fresh synthesis handoff includes the actual accepted reading/evidence/ledger bytes and hashes, immutable source identities and access routes, exact corpus/knowledge cutoff, base versions, entrypoint, active claims and significant contrary cases, independent findings/dispositions, required versus optional gaps, current portrait obligations and mutable ownership. Supply enough analytical substance to rebuild the argument, not only hyperlinks or a terse summary. The receiving agent acknowledges what it actually retrieved and inspected; missing evidence limits its authority.

Fresh synthesis returns provenance-bearing proposed changes and new work. The local integrator verifies source boundaries, significant claims, counterevidence and dependency propagation before accepting it. Completed prose does not itself establish required AV/text coverage, portrait fidelity, or reconstruction readiness. Final synthesis cannot be complete while required channels, material factual disputes or qualified portrait obligations remain unresolved. Optional enrichment may remain open with explicit consequences.

Named-subject handoff verification follows the handoff contract's §15: preserve stable identity, source-language names, purposeful roles and knowledge-bounded aliases; verify that material named people remain retrievable in the transferred synopsis, evidence and analysis. Inspect introduction, middle and latest/exit material where present, major relationships and any consequential minority/secondary contribution. Record what was checked and repair unexplained generic-label substitution or loss of a person's causal role before accepting the affected handoff.

At bootstrap all of these execution records are absent because no run is authorized. The sole next sequential operation remains `NONE_AWAITING_RUN_AUTHORIZATION`.
